entities.name: Shadowmoor (anthology)
entities.description: The first book of the Shadowmoor Cycle, an anthology with a novella and short stories, published April 2008.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The dark, twisted world that Lorwyn becomes after the Great Aurora, full of horrors lurking in the shadows.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The daylit world whose beauty is forgotten by all but a precious few after the Great Aurora.

entities.name: The Great Aurora
entities.description: The event that ends the daylit world of Lorwyn and brings an epoch of darkness.

entities.name: Mistmeadow
entities.description: A kithkin doun endangered by the approach of Rosheen Meanderer.

entities.name: Kinscaer
entities.description: The largest and mightiest kithkin doun, led by cenn Donal Alloway.

entities.name: Jack Chierdagh
entities.description: A kithkin sent to retrieve an item of Rosheen's to drive her away; he becomes the Hero of Mistmeadow.

entities.name: Donal Alloway
entities.description: Cenn of Kinscaer, who repels Maralen and sends Jack on his mission.

entities.name: Rosheen Meanderer
entities.description: A figure whose approach endangers Mistmeadow and who owns a scroll the faeries steal.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: A faerie who offers Mistmeadow protection and later sends Veesa and Iliona.

entities.name: Brigid the Brigand
entities.description: A strange non-Shadowmoorish kithkin who gives Jack her magical flying bow.

entities.name: Captain Sygg
entities.description: A merrow captain whose gang meets Jack.

entities.name: Ascaeus
entities.description: An optimistic cinder sootstoke who seeks a river of burning stone to rekindle his flames.

entities.name: Joram
entities.description: A hornless elf boy bearing the mark of the Raven, born in Strongroot, who takes a copper sphere from Amur.

entities.name: Tekla Ironleaf
entities.description: One of the five leaders of Strongroot safehold and Joram's mother.

entities.name: Amur
entities.description: A treefolk canker witch who gives Joram the copper sphere and leads the black poplar army.

entities.name: Mullenix
entities.description: A druid and council member of Strongroot who touches the sphere.

entities.name: Strongroot
entities.description: An elvish safehold destroyed by the black poplar army.

entities.name: Meme
entities.description: A boggart-raised orphaned elf girl, mocked as a strange boggart.

entities.name: Gog
entities.description: A boggart soul-eating shaman whose lackeys hunt Meme.

entities.name: Yasgo
entities.description: A boggart raider who turns out to be a tacharan, a ghost pawn of the banshee.

entities.name: Valya
entities.description: An elvish warrior from Lochran safehold seeking to avenge her parents; she kills the banshee.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The faerie queen of Shadowmoor who orders the Druai slain.

entities.name: The Druai
entities.description: A faerie holding the title Druai, whose spell to drain darkness from the world fails.

entities.name: The Scion
entities.description: A faerie who serves Oona and kills the Druai on her order.

entities.name: Wyb Cenniks
entities.description: A kithkin of Graymeadow doun, father of Gwyb.

entities.name: Gwyb Cenniks
entities.description: A young kithkin of Graymeadow beginning his service keeping watch.

entities.name: Dagub
entities.description: An old one-eyed kithkin who survived a failed expedition to the river.

entities.name: Isleback Spawn
entities.description: A tentacled beast that looks like a hill and slew an expedition of kithkin.

entities.name: Lishe
entities.description: An almost extinguished and insane cinder sootstoke who collects skulls.

entities.name: Virkole
entities.description: A cinder who attacks treefolk seeking the fire and is shattered.

entities.name: Ehroe
entities.description: Leader of the safewrights of Dusklight safehold, who keeps the hope of the Cloudbreaker alive through deceit.

entities.name: Eily
entities.description: An elf healer reputed to be a seer, who is really a scribe interpreting Callem's words.

entities.name: Cavan
entities.description: Ehroe's deputy among the safewrights.

entities.name: Callem the Builder
entities.description: A giant who builds stone towers and is the true seer.

entities.name: Tyack
entities.description: Cenn of the kithkin village Ballygol.

entities.name: Dusklight safehold
entities.description: An elvish settlement in Shadowmoor surrounded by swamp and attacked by merfolk.

entities.name: Ballygol
entities.description: A kithkin village that holds a Wellspring Lyre and is burned down.

entities.name: The Cloudbreaker
entities.description: A mystical artifact said to summon the Ally and restore beauty, hidden in the merrow's lake.

entities.name: Wander
entities.description: The first of five kithkin brothers in 'Five Brothers'; he dies after eating a poisonous mushroom.

entities.name: Cinders
entities.description: Fire-bodied creatures of Shadowmoor whose sootstokes seek to rekindle their flames.

events.summary: Maralen's offer of protection to Mistmeadow is repelled by Donal Alloway of Kinscaer.
events.quote: Maralen offers Mistmeadow a protection, but is repelled by Donal Alloway

events.summary: Jack Chierdagh is sent to retrieve an item of Rosheen's to drive her away from Mistmeadow.
events.quote: Jack Chierdagh is sent to retrieve an item of Rosheen to drive her away

events.summary: The faeries help Jack win the day by stealing Rosheen's scroll, driving her away.
events.quote: The faeries help Jack win the day, and drive Rosheen away by stealing a scroll of hers

events.summary: Jack returns and becomes the Hero of Mistmeadow.
events.quote: He returns to Mistmeadow and assume the position of the Hero of Mistmeadow

events.summary: The first of the five kithkin brothers, Wander, is tricked by fae into a swamp and dies from a poisonous mushroom.
events.quote: Wander is tricked by fae to go into a swamp, and perishes after eating a poisonous mushroom

events.summary: The brothers' village is later destroyed by cinders because its five most important members died.
events.quote: Their village is later destroyed by cinders, because its five most important members died

events.summary: Ascaeus finds the river of molten stone but his laugh collapses the cave behind him, and he embraces the river hoping to rekindle.
events.quote: In the end, he finds the river, but in his joy, he laughs -- and brings the cave to collapse and cut him off from a way back to surface.

events.summary: Joram uses the copper sphere from Amur to grow horns.
events.quote: Joram uses the copper sphere (the artifact) to grow horns

events.summary: When Mullenix touches the sphere, black tendrils sprout and the canker consumes the councilors, including Tekla, Joram's mother.
events.quote: Black tendrils sprout from it, and the councilors, including Tekla, Joram's mother, are consumed by the merciless canker disease

events.summary: Amur leads the black poplar army, destroying the safehold and slaying every elf but Joram.
events.quote: It is destroyed and all elves present are slain by the poplars, save for Joram

events.summary: Meme turns out to be an orphaned elf girl raised by a boggart mother.
events.quote: Meme is an orphaned elf girl who was adopted and brought up by a boggart mother

events.summary: Elves from the wood strike down the boggarts in the showdown against Meme.
events.quote: the boggarts are suddenly stricken down by elves from the wood

events.summary: A banshee slays Yasgo's two companions with her howl.
events.quote: A banshee slew them with her howl

events.summary: The banshee reveals that Yasgo is only a tacharan, a ghost pawn belonging to her.
events.quote: reveals that the boggart is no more than a tacharan, a ghost appearing as a living creature

events.summary: The Scion kills the Druai on Oona's order for failing and defying her.
events.quote: he is slain by the Scion upon Oona's order for failing and defying her orders

events.summary: Valya, protected by her herbs, wakes and kills the banshee; Yasgo fades away.
events.quote: kills the banshee by ramming her sword through it

events.summary: Young Gwyb on his first watch sees a dark shape in the water and thinks of the Isleback Spawn, spreading panic through the mindweft.
events.quote: During his first watch, the young Gwyb sees a dark shape in the water, and he cannot refrain from thinking about the Isleback Spawn.

events.summary: Virkole attacks treefolk seeking the fire and is overwhelmed and shattered.
events.quote: he is overwhelmed and shattered by the treefolk crowd

events.summary: Lishe collects Virkole's skull for his collection.
events.quote: Lishe then walks to the site, collects Virkole's cold skull

events.summary: At Ballygol, Ehroe shoots Tyack in the back when he refuses to produce the Cloudbreaker.
events.quote: Ehroe shoots him in the back

events.summary: Ehroe orders Ballygol searched and burned with its citizens.
events.quote: He then orders Ballygol to be searched thoroughly and then burned down, along with its citizens

events.summary: The seeds Ehroe gave Eily sprout into cramoisy, a deadly poison flower, not dawnglove.
events.quote: it is not dawnglove, but a different sort of flower, one of fable -- cramoisy, a killing flower, whose poison is extra deadly

events.summary: Eily confesses to Cavan that she is no seer but Callem's scribe.
events.quote: she is no seer, but a scribe and an interpreter of Callem the giant's words

events.summary: A merrow attack with a fear elemental kills twelve elves until Cavan shoots the beast down.
events.quote: twelve elves are killed by the fear until Cavan, guided by Eily, shoots the beast down

events.summary: Ehroe poisons the merrow's lake with cramoisy, killing the merrow, and the elves retrieve the Cloudbreaker.
events.quote: Ehroe pours the cramoisy extract into the lake, and soon it is full of bloated, dead merrow

events.summary: Cavan strangles Ehroe for the deception.
events.quote: strangles him with a leather strap

events.summary: Cavan stabs Eily and rides off to embrace the dark things that are coming.
events.quote: Cavan kisses Eily, and then drives his dagger into her belly
